description: Hardcode/burn subtitles directly into video frames with customizable font size, colors, and positioning. Unlike soft subtitles, burned subtitles render on all platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

fontColor.description: Primary subtitle text color: 'white', 'yellow', 'cyan', or ASS hex e.g. '&H00FFFFFF'. Default: 'white'.

fontSize.description: Subtitle font size in points. Default: 24.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding when available. Default: true.

marginV.description: Vertical margin distance in pixels from the bottom edge. Default: 35.

outlineColor.description: Subtitle border/outline color: 'black', 'white', or ASS hex. Default: 'black'.

subtitlesPath.description: Path to the subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, or .ass) to burn into the video.

videoPath.description: Path to the source video file.

name: burn_subtitles
